post.description:
Every change waiting for a decision must be accepted or rejected. The decision is
recorded as a new cleaning plan revision (who and when), the person's names, units,
exclusions, target and features are saved for the dataset's next runs, and the run
continues. ``412`` when the run or its cleaning plan changed since you loaded them.

finishes; 409 ``dashboard-not-available`` for a report written before dashboards).
get.summary: The finished run's dashboard: tiles, top charts, maps, suggested questions

post.description:
Keeps only the rows whose ``column`` is one of ``values`` (a chart's ``drill_column``
and its points' ``key``) and analyses them again with the run's approved plan and
cleaning; no review, no planning. The new run's facts are labelled exploratory. ``409``
when the run has not finished, is itself a drill-down, or was made by an earlier version;
``422`` when the column cannot be explored.

Saves your cleaning decisions so far, column edits, removed questions and requests in
your own words, then plans again: the engine first, then the planning model if one is
configured. Finished steps whose inputs did not change are reused. The run returns to
review with an outcome for every request. ``412`` when the run or its cleaning plan
changed since you loaded them.

templates because the model was unavailable). The facts, tests and charts are reused; only
the words are written again, as a new revision of the report. ``409``
``narration-not-retryable`` otherwise.
